verdict.rationale: The repo ships a dedicated meta-skill, skill-creator, for creating, iterating on, benchmarking and optimizing skills, plus a template SKILL.md and a formal Agent Skills spec covering frontmatter rules and directory layout. Packaging and distribution are documented through plugin manifests, local `--plugin-dir` testing, marketplaces and Skills API upload; a runtime probe confirmed skill-creator installs cleanly, and a community user reports having Claude Code create and organize skills. Missing for 10: a hands-on recorded run of an agent using skill-creator to author AND package a new skill end to end (the probe only installed the meta-skill), and explicit evidence that skill-creator itself handles the packaging step.
